name: Hajimete wa Osananajimi -2nd Season- Pretty Sisters
original_name: はじめては幼馴染 -2nd Season- pretty sisters
source:
Protagonist Takahiro was dating Nao, the perky younger girl next door.
But work took him far away, and for two long years they didn't feel each other's touch.
At last they could reunite.

Takahiro didn't think anything would get in the way of their love, but...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ112174.html]DLsite English[/url]]
